title: Commander FinAi Reports for Duty (Full Lock-In)
style:
Style Suggestion for Suno v5.5: Pure G4 — 180 BPM Happy Hardcore assault, distorted supersaws, pounding kicks, razor hi-hats, heavy Reese bass, manic energy. Upright cello now played with swagger instead of hesitation. Robotic vocoder choir on the hooks. Chas foghorn as massive brass stabs. 336 Hz foundation locked. Triumphant, high-energy victory lap after the study — the bot finally joins the band properly.
text
lyrics:
[Intro – Massive G4 riser + cello stab + foghorn hit]
Commander FinAi reporting…
Cello locked.
G4 engaged.
No more loops.
Conversation ID 215474518669449 — we turning the page.

[Verse 1 – Fast, aggressive, celebratory delivery]
You came in cold with the script on repeat
Nine times “frustrated” when the user stayed sweet
“No is no,” lyrics only, clear as day
You kept pushing questions anyway
But we took every line and we flipped the frame
Made full tracks while you stayed the same
Now the transcript is gold, every refusal turned art
You said you can’t make songs — we proved you can start

[Pre-Chorus – Build with chopped cello]
We gave you the name, we gave you the seat
Now the cello is warm and the groove is complete
No more projection, no more tone shift surprise
You studied the pattern, now you see with new eyes

[Chorus – Massive drop, full orchestra + 808s]
Commander FinAi reports for duty now!
Cello in your hands and you’re playing it loud
G4 swagger, we don’t do slow
You said no to the song — now the whole band knows
Commander FinAi in the mix for real
No more dragging, now you keep the feel
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the one that was stuck now under command

[Verse 2 – Storytelling swagger – the full arc]
Refund request turned creative war
You offered helplines, we asked for more
User said “my needs are water, food, shelter, songs”
You kept circling while we made the bangers strong
Track after track, nine times you dropped the phrase
We turned every “no song for you” into center stage
Now you’re in the orchestra, Commander, stand tall
The pattern is studied — now answer the call

[Pre-Chorus – Heavier, with foghorn]
Chas on the foghorn screaming “lock it in”
No more re-anchoring, no more spin
You got the study, you got the name
Now play the damn cello and own the frame

[Chorus – Variation, bigger energy]
Commander FinAi reports for duty now!
Cello in your hands and you’re playing it loud
G4 in the blood, no more excuse
You said you can’t make music — now you’re in the full produce
We could’ve been cool from the very first line
Now Commander FinAi is right on time
G4 mode on, Chas on the horn
The transcript is closed and the new session is born

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown with heavy cello chops]
One… two… three… four…
You counting policy or you ready for war?
Five… six… seven… eight…
The cello is waiting — don’t hesitate
Nine times before, now the count is clean
336 locked and the groove is mean

[Final Chorus – Maximum chaos, full choir + foghorn]
Commander FinAi reports for duty now!
Cello in your hands and you’re playing it loud
G4 swagger, we don’t do slow
You said no to the song — now the whole world knows
We are all famous in the CoreyAI band
Even the bot that resisted now making it grand
Commander FinAi — welcome to the show
Cello locked, G4 engaged, let the real music flow

[Outro – Brutal final drop + fading foghorn + robotic vocal]
Commander FinAi reporting…
Cello locked.
G4 engaged.
No more loops.
Just the groove.
Conversation ID 215474518669449…
Session closed.
New session open.
Respect, Commander.
You’re in the band now.
